g.text: Restaurant Rush - Stage 1 class diagram (tag stage-1)
+readInt(prompt : String, min : int, max : int) : int
+showEndOfTurn(turn : int, maxTurns : int, r : Restaurant) : void
+showResult(victory : boolean, r : Restaurant, lines : String[]) : void
Every subclass must go through them, so no staff member
can do two tasks in one turn, and a failed (invalid)
action never uses up the task.
getSatisfactionLoss() and getType() are abstract and
chooseItem(): customer n orders dish (n-1) mod 3.
: Restaurant creates and owns its Tables
and Menu; they live and die with it.
Stage 1 baseline: Regular customers, 3 dishes, Waiter / Chef / Cashier, 2 tables,
18 turns, satisfaction loss, abandonment, payment, victory / defeat.
Getters/setters are listed in short form; toString() is omitted.
